messages:
sam: quick flag tokenizer v2 caused a small spike in near-dup splits on the onboarding holdout (~2.7%). looks concentrated on urls and emoji sequences.
li: can you paste a minimal repro?
sam: sure, two examples in the canary pack: 
- "Check this link: https://ex.com/a?ref=1" vs "Check this link https://ex.com/a?ref=1" (diff is punctuation tokenization)
- "Congrats! 🎉" vs "Congrats 🎉" (emoji spacing)
maria: likely a unicode normalization change in the tokenizer. quantization not implicated yet but shows up because canary used quant3b-int8. we should confirm on fp16 too.
li: create a tiny relabel batch (20 items) focusing on these edgecases and tag high-frequency ones. labeler-bot, can you spin that up?
labeler-bot: created review_batches/4498765432-tokenizer-unicode (20 items)  rubric: merge_if_meaning_same / split_if_diff / note_normalization 
ci-bot: quick test added to CI: run-harness --emit-token-forms --compare-tokenizer v1,v2, outputs to s3://redwood-eval/4498765432/token_diff.csv
sam: interim mitigation: for canary only, lower fingerprint_threshold 0.86 -> 0.83. not changing prod. will log delta.
li: please avoid global changes. use canary override and run v1/v2 diff.
maria: if relabelers mark >5 items as split_if_diff we should prepare a golden refresh PR. otherwise patch tokenizer normalization and roll back.
labeler-bot: progress: 6/20 completed, 1 split_if_diff (a URL with trailing slash), 2 notes about emoji spacing.
ci-bot: canary run complete. summary: raw delta=2.7%, with canary threshold override delta=1.1%. token_diff.csv uploaded.
sam: I'll open a draft PR for golden refresh if labels justify it. link when ready.
li: thanks. convene again if relabel finishes with >5 splits.
maria: thx everyone, keeping an eye on the CI artifacts.
